info.title: Midnight ZKIR Forge — initial HTTP subset
info.description: Single-owner service. Raw single-circuit uploads and synchronous materialization. No archives, durable jobs, namespaces, HTTP provider views or hosted registry guarantees. Bearer authentication is enforced when a token file is configured and required for non-loopback binding. No CORS; TLS belongs at a trusted reverse proxy. Parameter acquisition is an explicit operator option.
